name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-xml-set-children-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString, but not cloneReadOnly.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions"; value:cloneReadOnly is absent, while xml:setChildren is listed.
reason: The expected panic from setting children of a frozen XML element depends on x1.cloneReadOnly(), a langlib operation excluded from both the supported library functions and supported method-call lists. XML setChildren itself is supported, but the essential freezing operation makes this whole case a feature request.
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion checks mutation of the readonly XML value produced by cloneReadOnly, not merely XML construction or setChildren availability.
